verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an official MCP server that agents can use to 'Check a domain name availability', alongside a general API with 120+ actions. However, the API evidence never names an availability-check or search endpoint, and no rate limits are documented. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicitly documented availability/search API endpoint, published rate limits, a machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check domain availability programmatically — a documented check/search API my code or agent can call with clear rate limits

citations.quote: Dynadot MCP is an easier way to manage your domains, just by talking to an AI assistant.
Our API supports more than 120 actions
